# Code of conduct

Odyssey is built by students and beginners learning together, in the spirit of FIRST's
*Gracious Professionalism*. Everyone taking part (in issues, pull requests, reviews, or anywhere
else in this project) is expected to:

- **Be kind and patient.** Questions are welcome, including "basic" ones. Nobody should feel stupid
  for asking.
- **Assume good intent.** Criticize code and ideas, not people. Explain *why* when you disagree.
- **Help people learn.** When you review, point the way rather than just saying "wrong".
- **Respect people's time and work.** Say thanks, give credit, and don't take over someone's work
  without asking.

Not acceptable: harassment, insults, discrimination, or personal attacks of any kind.

## If something goes wrong

Contact the maintainer, [@saquer916](https://github.com/saquer916), privately, or open an issue if
you're comfortable doing that publicly. Reports are taken seriously and kept confidential. Anyone
who breaks this code may be asked to stop, have comments removed, or be blocked from the project.
